blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY — A female green sea turtle tagged in Sabah, Malaysia, was rescued after it was found struggling to return to the sea off Pangangan Island in Calape town, Bohol, on Wednesday, Nov. 4. The turtle, identified through tags attached to its front flippers, was previously monitored at Turtle Islands Park in Sandakan, Sabah, indicating that it had traveled from Malaysian waters to the Philippines.
